meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档转换成带 kawaii 角色叙述的幻灯片 PDF，并上传到 WOWerpoint Server 生成 9:16 手机版分享链接；PDF 存在源文件旁。只做幻灯片，不做视频或播客。
howto.when: 当用户说“Wowerpoint 这个文件”“把这份报告做成幻灯片”“给<文件>做一个演示文稿”，或提出把单个文档渲染成可分享叙述型幻灯片时触发。

say.text: Wowerpoint 这份季度总结报告
say.note: 会生成叙述型幻灯片 PDF 和分享链接

say.text: 把这篇市场分析做成幻灯片演示文稿
say.note: 源文档会被转成 kawaii 风格幻灯片

say.text: 给这份产品说明做一套可爱画风的幻灯片
say.note: 还可获得手机版 9:16 分享链接

howto.what_en: Turns one document into a kawaii-character slide-deck PDF, uploads it to the WOWerpoint Server for a 9:16 mobile twin, and returns a share URL. The PDF is saved next to the source. Slide-deck only — no videos or podcasts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "Wowerpoint this", "make a slide deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or asks to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

say_en.note: Generates a narrative slide-deck PDF and a share link.

say_en.text: Turn this market analysis into a slide deck
Make a cute deck out of this product brief
say_en.note: You also get a 9:16 mobile share link.
